system.description:
You immediately take 40 points of direct damage. After use, you can declare transparency when attacked. If you declare it, you take no damage from the attack and immediately become [Hidden]. This effect is treated as a condition, and once it is applied, it is removed. (CR21) This item has no effect. A powerful elixir that grants the ability to hide one's body, creating a dense night darkness as if the strong moonlight were melting. It has a translucent, rice-husk color resembling the moonlight dissolved, and is also used as a cosmetic.

Transparent Blood [Core Material] (220G) + Unyielding Ointment (Basic) (190G) + Stealth Scroll (Basic) (100G) + [Magic Catalyst 10] (110G) ×2 + Crafting Cost (340G)
